claims: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites aboard a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:50 p.m. PDT.
The launch followed a Sunday scrub.
The Falcon 9 booster landed on the Of Course I Still Love You drone ship in the Pacific Ocean.
The latest launch was from Space Launch Complex 4E, Vandenberg Space Force Base, California.
The latest launch had a payload of 25 Starlink satellites.
The latest launch had a southerly trajectory.
Additional Starlink missions are scheduled for April 9 and 11.
As of April 6, 2026, SpaceX has an upcoming launch on April 8 called NG-24 Mission.
